verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services such as venture financings, IP and employment work. Official developer SDKs fall outside this kind of product. The evidence shows no first-party software platform or SDK: the OpenAPI probe returned 404, and the Clerky partnership is a third-party formation platform, not a Lowenstein SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
